column1: # The names of AutoHotkey v2.0.19 that this tree does not carry yet.
# A name that the tree carries is not listed here, even when v2 spells
# it in two shapes: a name of a class and a name of a function are two
# places, and the tree has to have both.
# A name is carried when the tree answers it. The answer may be a value
# or the reason the tree cannot give one, so a name that is shaped for
# Windows is carried and is not listed here.
# kind      command, function, variable or method
# class     the class a method belongs to, empty otherwise
# name      the name, as v2 spells it
# reason    why the tree does not carry it yet
# windows   the name is about a Windows API that a Linux desktop does
# hotkey    the name is about the hotkey system.
# class     the name is a method of a class type that is not here yet.
# variable  the name is a built-in variable that is not here yet.
# not-yet   the name is here, and it is still to do.
